procedures.title: Multi-Engine Operation Protocol - Single Engine Running
preconditions: Installation with two or three engines
steps: Close water pickup (thru-hull) of non-running engines
Limit throttle to 2/3 maximum on running engine
Reduce throttle if engine speed doesn't increase with throttle movement
Maintain reduced throttle where engine performs normally
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of engine damage and proper performance of running engine

procedures.title: Battery Operation Safety Protocol
steps: Never turn off battery switch during operation
Never short battery cables during operation
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of electrical system damage

procedures.title: Engine Safety Procedure - Hot Cap Removal
preconditions: Engine is running or recently shut down
steps: Wait for engine to completely cool down before removing cap
Ensure engine is not hot to touch
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe cap removal without risk of burns

procedures.title: Engine Operation - Maximum Throttle Usage
steps: Limit maximum throttle operation to less than 5% of total engine time
Do not exceed 30 minutes of maximum throttle per 10 hours of operation
Maintain cruising speed at 200 min-1 or less below fuel stop power engine speed
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper engine operation within design parameters

procedures.title: Safety Protocol - Rotating Parts
steps: Keep all body parts away from rotating engine components
Ensure all protective covers are in place
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of injury from rotating parts

procedures.title: Engine Protection - Water Lift Muffler Operation

procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of water lift muffler damage

procedures.title: New Engine Break-In First 10 Hours
steps: Run engine at maximum speed minus 400-500 min-1 (60-70% load) most of the time
Monitor coolant temperature to stay between 71-87°C (160-190°F)
Avoid maximum engine speed and load
Do not operate at WOT for more than 1 minute at a time
Do not operate at low idle/speed/light load for more than 30 minutes
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper break-in of sliding parts and stabilized engine combustion

procedures.title: Carbon Cleaning Procedure
steps: Accelerate from low-speed to high-speed position briefly
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean carbon from cylinders and fuel injection valve

procedures.title: Engine Break-In 10-50 Hours
steps: Run at maximum speed minus 400 min-1 (70% load) most of the time
Every 30 minutes, run for 10 minutes at maximum minus 200 min-1 (80% load)
Every 30 minutes, operate at WOT for 4-5 minutes
Avoid low speed/light load operation for more than 30 minutes
If operating at low speed/load, race engine afterward
procedures.expected_outcome: Completed engine break-in

procedures.expected_outcome: Air purged from fuel filter

Confirm ash content does not exceed 0.01% by volume

Clean around filler port before filling
Do not mix different types or brands of oil
Replace oil at specified intervals regardless of engine operation
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper handling and storage of engine oil

procedures.title: Checking Engine Oil Level

Check oil level is between upper and lower lines
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper oil level confirmed

procedures.title: Adding Engine Oil

procedures.expected_outcome: Engine oil properly filled to correct level

procedures.title: Checking Marine Gear Oil

procedures.expected_outcome: Marine gear oil level is at upper limit on dipstick

procedures.title: Checking and Adding Sail Drive Oil

procedures.expected_outcome: Oil level between upper and lower lines on dipstick
models: YANMAR JH Series with Sail Drive

procedures.title: Engine Coolant Mixing Guidelines
preconditions: Using proper LLC compatible with engine materials
steps: Follow manufacturer's recommended mixing ratios for temperature range
Maintain LLC concentration between 30% minimum and 60% maximum
Never mix different types or brands of LLC
Use only specified coolant types (Texaco LLC or Havoline Extended Life)
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper engine coolant mixture prepared

procedures.title: Coolant Mixing Guidelines
preconditions: Have Havoline Extended Life Antifreeze/Coolant or proper LLC
steps: Follow manufacturer's recommended mixing ratios for temperature range
Maintain LLC concentration between 30% minimum and 60% maximum
Do not exceed maximum concentration as it decreases cooling efficiency
Never mix different types or brands of LLC
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly mixed coolant that won't damage engine components

procedures.title: Adding/Checking Engine Coolant
preconditions: All drain cocks must be closed
steps: Verify all drain cocks are closed
Loosen coolant tank filler cap slowly to relieve pressure
Pour coolant slowly into coolant tank to avoid air bubbles
Fill until coolant overflows from filler port
Align filler cap tabs with filler port notches
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper coolant level achieved with secure cap installation

procedures.title: Safety Procedure - Hot Coolant Handling
preconditions: Engine is hot or recently running
steps: Allow engine to cool down completely before removing coolant cap
Loosen cap slowly to relieve pressure before removal
Never pour cold coolant into hot engine
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of burns from hot coolant or steam

procedures.title: Checking and Adding Engine Coolant
steps: Check coolant level in reservoir - should be at FULL mark
If needed, remove reservoir cap to add coolant
Do not add water, only use proper coolant
Install filler cap and tighten firmly
Check rubber hose connecting reservoir to coolant tank/heat exchanger
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper coolant level maintained and system integrity verified

procedures.title: Engine Starting Safety Procedure
steps: Only use start switch on instrument panel
Ensure marine gear is in NEUTRAL position
Verify boat is in open water away from obstacles
Keep children and pets away from operating engine
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe engine start conditions established

procedures.title: Water Lift Muffler Starting Procedure
